title: Elon Musk tried to hire OpenAI founders to start AI unit inside Tesla
brief: Elon Musk attempted to recruit OpenAI founders Sam Altman and Greg Brockman to lead an AI division within Tesla, seeking control over the unit as a condition for funding it as a for-profit entity. The effort underscores ongoing tensions between Musk and OpenAI leadership following his earlier lawsuit against the company over its transition to for-profit structure.
